diagnosis.cause: The apt installer selects SIGINT together with --kill-after. The official uutils coreutils 0.10.0 Linux release reproduces the hosted mismatch: timeout --signal=INT --kill-after=2s 1s sleep 30 exits 137 in 1.004s; the same command with TERM or the default signal exits 124. The full apt self-test, run with this verified binary as timeout, reproduces both update/install failures. Separately, backticks around timeout in a comment inside the test's unquoted STUB heredoc execute five no-argument timeout commands and create parser noise. Repair the installer signal to TERM, retain timeout/retry bounds, and remove those comment backticks.
